metrics.correctness: Score is passed deterministic tests divided by executed valid tests. Separate instructor, generated normal, generated boundary and property tests. Never infer a pass for an unexecuted test. Failed cases must show input, oracle expected output, actual output and exit/timeout state.
metrics.logical: Use deterministic assignment-specific invariants and edge/property tests. Explain the invariant each case targets; do not double-count correctness cases unless the instructor separates the metrics.
metrics.syntax: Use the pinned compiler, language standard and exact flags. Compile errors fail; warnings follow explicit configured deductions. Never infer compilation from source inspection.
metrics.structure: Use pinned static-analysis diagnostics and explicit instructor thresholds, with source locations and severities.
metrics.modularity: Apply only the instructor's decomposition contract. Do not assume helper functions are mandatory unless the task/rubric says so.
metrics.complexity: Assess asymptotic time and space against the required bound using algorithm and input constraints. Cyclomatic complexity and function length are not Big-O. Return inconclusive if the bound cannot be established.
metrics.memory_safety: Every enabled check must complete. Distinguish actual defects from tool failures and incomplete executions. Tool failure is unmeasured, not clean.
metrics.readability: Use explicit criteria for names, comments where useful, formatting, decomposition and maintainability. Avoid personal style penalties without instructor criteria.
metrics.originality: Token and structural similarity are review signals, not proof of plagiarism. No punitive deduction without explicit instructor policy and human review.
